body.x: NationA INC. (CEO Suyeon Yoo) announced that it will participate in CES 2025, held from January 7th (Tuesday) to January 10th (Friday) in Las Vegas, USA, under the "K-Startup Pavilion."

NationA is a South Korean startup specializing in generative AI-based 3D content creation. Earlier this year, it won two Innovation Awards at CES 2024, receiving global recognition for its technological competitiveness and innovation.

Last October, NationA introduced its automated 3D animation generation solution, ‘Nueroid,’ which was highly acclaimed in global markets. Building on this success, the company has collaborated with major domestic and international tech firms. Following the successful launch and growth of Nueroid, the company plans to launch its new service, ‘Hey.D.’

At CES 2025, NationA will showcase an updated version of its flagship product, Nueroid Next, aiming to expand its global customer base. Nueroid Next generates 3D motion content based on user input prompts, aligning with the context provided.

Nueroid is renowned for its versatility in automatically generating data for AR, VR, robot motion, 3D content, and industrial 3D applications. As a SaaS (Software as a Service) platform, it offers exceptional accessibility, enabling users to create desired motion data within seconds.

In marketing, Nueroid has proven highly effective among 3D game developers and 3D content creators. Within a month of its launch in October, the service attracted over one million global users, nearly half of whom were based in the United States. Recognized for its outstanding utility, Nueroid has again been selected for an Innovation Award at CES.
NationA will also demonstrate its new service, Hey.D, which has received an Innovation Award for its high potential.

Hey.D combines a small large-language model (sLLM) with a 3D foundation model to offer an immersive chat service featuring 3D characters. This service exemplifies the company’s strategy to drive further growth and innovation.

A NationA representative stated, “We aim to revolutionize the 3D content creation market through our proprietary generative AI technology and its applications. By offering user-friendly tools for global creators, we seek to achieve widespread adoption. To realize this goal, we plan to meet international investors and buyers at CES 2025 to create new business opportunities.”

The representative added, “Through the global network established at the world’s largest tech exhibition, we will accelerate efforts to expand our user base not only in the United States but across various national markets worldwide.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
